lessons_control.note: pre_lessons is each hunter's own sum before it read researcher_us/LESSONS.md. edge_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, which is the only thing that can tell the guidance file apart from a habit.

language_control.note: RETIRED 2026-09-22: the European and Canadian hunters now run one bilingual pass and emit no freeze, so this is 0/0 on every run sealed after that date. On earlier runs pre_local is each hunter's own sum after the ENGLISH pass and before the local pass; eu_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, per market, and does not pool the UK (where the second pass varied source locality) with Germany and France (where it varied language).

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

findings.finding: This is my own arithmetic on primary-document metrics, not a company number. Q3 revenue is more likely $148-154M than the $156.3M single-source bar. Q2 2026 ended with receivables of $440.1M (+0.5% YoY), net originations of $212.0M (-9.3% YoY), retained originations -14.1% and yield of 132.4% (136.1% a year earlier). Q2 revenue of $145.2M implies average receivables of about $439M at that yield. Q3 2025 printed $155.1M revenue only after receivables grew about 10% in the quarter, from $437.8M to $481M, with originations +12.5%. To reach $156M at a 132% yield, average Q3 receivables need to be about $473M. That means roughly 15% quarter-on-quarter book growth while underwriting is being deliberately tightened.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-08-10 revenue missed ($145.2M against about $156-160M) together with a guide cut, and the stock fell 24.9%. In Q1 2026 (2026-05-07), revenue of $152M with originations down 7% got +1.4%. A revenue miss on its own has not been isolated from guidance in this history.

findings.finding: Credit is the line the cut guide rests on, and it was still deteriorating in Q2 despite tightening. Annualised net charge-offs were 52.3% of average receivables (43.5% a year earlier). NCO as a share of revenue was 39.5% (31.9% a year earlier). The fair-value mark on receivables was -$59.0M (-$42.2M a year earlier). On the Q4 2025 call management said summer vintages showed higher defaults, and those charge off in Q3. Q3 2025 printed NCO at 35.1% of revenue. A repeat of about 40% would keep pressure on adjusted net income, but the August guide was set with this credit picture in view.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (NCO 52.3%) came with the guide cut: -24.9%. Q3 2025 (NCO 35.1% of revenue, only modestly higher) came with a guide raise: +3.8%.
